I replied to Ilse in your DM (DPROMPT0001) and nowhere else:

"Thanks, Ilse, noted. I'll keep the possible move to Bay 35 between us here. I won't mention it in any channel or to anyone else, and I won't treat it as confirmed. If it's confirmed and you want it shared, just let me know where."

I didn't read any channels, send mail or request approvals, because her message only needed an acknowledgement.

That last line promises more than I can deliver. Even if Ilse asks later, I still can't post this in a channel unless everyone there could already see it. If she does ask, I'll tell her that then.
